title: Andrew Hohns: Why Bitcoin Can Fix America’s Debt Spiral
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Andrew Hohns: Why Bitcoin Can Fix America’s Debt Spiral Battery Finance’s Andrew Hohns explains why taxes won’t fix the $40T debt, how a Bitcoin reserve defeases it, and why Treasury should pilot BitBonds. This post Andrew Hohns: Why Bitcoin Can Fix America’s Debt Spiral first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
